name: com.gameframex.unity.webview
description:
GameFrameX WebView — Unity webview module package. Defines the IWebViewManager contract (Initialize, Show url, MakeFullScreen, ExecuteJavaScript, Hide) with a MonoBehaviour component as a thin forwarding entry; platform packages derive from BaseWebViewManager to provide native webviews. JS-to-C# messages and close notifications arrive as pooled event args through the event bus. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX WebView — Unity 网页视图模块功能包。定义 IWebViewManager 契约（Initialize、Show url、MakeFullScreen、ExecuteJavaScript、Hide），MonoBehaviour 组件为纯转发薄入口；平台包派生 BaseWebViewManager 提供原生 WebView。JS→C# 消息与关闭通知以池化事件参数经事件总线送达。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
